package dynamoevents

import (
 \"encoding/json\"
 \"testing\"

 \"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/aws\"
 \"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/dynamodb\"
 \"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
)

func TestFieldsMapRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
 original := []byte("'`{"actor":"alice","large":9007199254740993,"nested":{"enabled":true,"missing":null,"values":["",1.25,false]}}`)
 item := map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{"Fields": {S: aws.String(string(original))}}
 require.NoError(t, setFieldsMap(item, original))
 require.Nil(t, item["Fields"])
 require.Equal(t, "alice", *item[keyFieldsMap].M["actor"].S)
 require.Equal(t, "9007199254740993", *item[keyFieldsMap].M["large"].N)
 require.NotNil(t, item[keyFieldsMap].M["nested"].M)
 require.NoError(t, validateFieldsMap(original, item))
 converted, err := fieldsFromItem(item)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 var value map[string]interface{}
 require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(converted, &value))
 require.Equal(t, "alice", value["actor"])
}

func TestFieldsMapLegacyFallback(t *testing.T) {
 original := `{"actor":"alice"}`
 item := map[string]*dynamodb.AttributeValue{"Fields": {S: aws.String(original)}}
 data, err := fieldsFromItem(item)
 require.NoError(t, err)
 require.Equal(t, original, string(data))
 require.Error(t, setFieldsMap(item, []byte(`{"invalid":`)))
}
EOF
